sources.title: YouCoded Assistant — Agentic AI for Everyone
sources.snippet: YouCoded is a customizable AI assistant that works with your own files and data to autonomously accomplish tasks using your computer. Review and organize large spreadsheets, compile the latest medical or financial research, draft an email or slideshow, or build new features in large coding projects, all without needing to leave the app.
